faqs.q: Sec. 18-519. - I.P.M.C. Section 308.7, Unlawful use of another's rubbish or garbage container.
faqs.a:
Section 308.7. Unlawful use of another's rubbish or garbage container,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
308.7. Unlawful use of another's rubbish or garbage container.
It shall be unlawful for any person to put, place or dump rubbish or garbage in,
                  on, under or around a rubbish or garbage container belonging to another except where
                  written permission for such use is granted by the owner or lessee of the real property
                  on which the dumpster or other rubbish or garbage container is located."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
